Magnitude 5.0 Earthquake Strikes Tibet After Floods

A magnitude 5.0 earthquake struck Tibet on Tuesday, days after devastating flash floods occurred in Nepal. The earthquake's epicenter was located in Tibet. Information regarding the earthquake and the preceding floods has been subject to strict controls by Chinese authorities, with limited details released by Beijing focusing on rescue operations. Content posted by citizens has been censored, and foreign journalists have been reportedly banned from entering the affected region.
